notable_exclusions_summary: Group health-style product (mentions Employee/Primary Insured definitions). Standard 24-month specific waiting (shorter than Acko Health III's 36). PA add-on benefit available with extensive disability schedule. Arbitration clause included.
available_riders: Reduction in Specific Illness Waiting Period
claim_process_summary: Cashless at network hospitals (planned 3 days before; emergency within 48 hours) or Reimbursement (15 days from discharge). Settlement within 15 days; penal interest 2% above bank rate. Moratorium 5 years.
